Vertical 9:16, ultra-photorealistic low-light smartphone selfie.

A fictional 27-year-old adult Japanese woman takes a casual close-range wide-angle selfie on a city sidewalk in Japan late at night.

The camera is positioned below her face, looking slightly upward. She leans toward the lens with one arm extended prominently into the foreground. Natural feminine proportions with a moderately full D-cup bust.

Her lips are slightly parted vertically, revealing her upper front teeth, with a candid, unguarded expression. Messy dark-brown layered hair, loose strands around her cheeks, flyaway hairs, realistic skin pores and subtle shine.

She wears an off-white ribbed sleeveless Henley tank top, a shaggy black jacket draped over one shoulder, a delicate silver cross necklace, and brown-framed sunglasses hanging from her neckline.

Large dark night sky overhead, bright amber streetlight in the upper right with a long vertical golden lens flare. Dark building facade on the left, utility wires, road signs, distant cars and pedestrians on the right.

Warm street lighting, cool blue-gray shadows, natural digital noise, slight handheld motion blur and imperfect exposure.

Authentic spontaneous social-media snapshot, not a polished commercial portrait.

No beauty filters, exaggerated anatomy, studio lighting, excessive background blur, CGI appearance, text, logos, watermarks or social-media UI.
